title: Safe Message
statement: Implement `solve(invoice_id, secret)`. Return the string `invoice {id} failed` with the id interpolated. The `secret` argument must not appear in the result. Ignoring the secret on purpose is the behavior.
hints: Build the message from the id only.
A test will pass a secret that must be absent. You can assert that by simply never reading it into the string.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Exception messages end up in logs and in API bodies.

editorial: Exception messages end up in logs and in API bodies. An invoice id is useful. A card number or token that happened to be in scope is not. Leaving the secret out of the format string is the fix. The unused argument is the temptation.
